identity.name: Panthère de Cartier

case.bezel: polished steel bezel integrated into the quilted-link bracelet

identity.one_liner: An integrated quilted-link bracelet watch that defined 1980s Cartier, revived in 2017 after roughly two decades out of the catalog.

narrative.story: Cartier launched the Panthère de Cartier in 1983, building the case and its flat quilted-link bracelet as one integrated piece rather than a case with a separate strap, styled toward the brand's jewelry-house identity rather than a tool-watch one. Cartier discontinued the line for roughly two decades before reviving it in 2017, reintroducing the same integrated-bracelet silhouette in steel, two-tone, and gold versions.
narrative.collector_notes: This steel-only medium reference (WSPN0015) sits at the entry point of a range that runs up through two-tone, diamond-set, and solid-gold versions at several times the price; confirm which generation and material a listing shows before comparing prices, since vintage 1980s-90s bracelets can develop play at the links from decades of wear.
